description: Create or update a budget for a category and budget period. The start_date must be a valid budget period start for the account (see get_budget_settings).

amount.description: Budget amount. A number, or a string with at most 4 decimal places (e.g. "125.5000").

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, e.g. "usd", "eur", "btc". Case-insensitive. Defaults to the account's primary currency.

notes.description: Optional notes for the budget period (max 350 characters). Accepts null.

start_date.description: Budget period start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be a valid budget period start; if not, the API returns the previous and next valid start dates.

name: upsert_budget
